title: PILLA: Parametric Information Layering Logic – Anatemnein
description: A geometric framework in which the manufactured surface of a pharmaceutical tablet becomes a recursively addressable, multiscale information substrate — simultaneously supporting human readability, clinical guidance, machine-readable identification, and anti-counterfeiting through engineered geometry, colour and surface texture. © 1993–2026 Abhishek Choudhary.
